pr.body:
<!-- Include a brief summary of the changes. -->
Replace Part::Feature::getTopoShape() and ::getShape() ' boolean parameters by flags and add a new flag to fix an edge case in holes centered on points where a single point would be ignored if it was alongside a single line. The Part::Feature::getTopoShape() has also been lightly refactored to remove some nesting.
